annotationRationale: Parity restricts the digit counts, and an exhaustive division into disjoint cases gives the total. Calendar facts are needed to reject invalid months and days.

methodReviews.mathCheck: The year leaves odd counts only for 0 and 3. Months 04 through 09 require days exceeding 31, and December leaves four odd counts. The remaining month groups contribute 4, 1, 2 and 2 valid dates, totaling 9. The exclusions and table are exhaustive and disjoint.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: Correctly reuses 2023_AMC_10A_Q09/complete-digit-pairs-by-month. Both inherited credits, live-reference-2023_AMC_10A_Q09 and randommath-reference-2023_AMC_10A_Q09, are retained. The project reuse is authorized by the supplied provenance, and source-informed-original correctly distinguishes it from an official MAA adaptation.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The parity rule explains the first move and every table row. Invalid equal-digit days and relevant month lengths are addressed. The supported table is clear and sufficient.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: cnm_p156 supplies odd/even counts, cnm_h230 supplies addition over disjoint month cases, and cnm_p091 supplies calendar validity. No unsupported technique is hidden.
